subject: Ciências
description_pt: Identificar os pontos cardeais, com base no registro de diferentes posições relativas do Sol e da sombra de uma vara (gnômon).

components.description_pt: Observar e registrar padrões na posição aparente ou movimento do sol no céu
components.description_en: Observe and record patterns in the apparent position or movement of the sun across the sky
components.cc_component_description: Observe and record patterns in the apparent position or movement of the sun across the sky

components.description_pt: Prever como o comprimento e a direção da sombra mudam ao longo do dia devido à rotação terrestre
components.description_en: Predict how shadow length and direction change throughout the day due to Earth's rotation
components.cc_component_description: Predict how shadow length and direction change throughout the day due to Earth's rotation

components.description_pt: Identificar direções cardeais baseando-se em observações de sombra de gnômon
components.description_en: Identify the cardinal directions (North, South, East, West) based on gnomon shadow observations
components.cc_component_description: Predict how shadow length and direction change throughout the day due to Earth's rotation

cc_matches.description: The orbits of Earth around the sun and of the moon around Earth, together with the rotation of Earth about an axis between its North and South poles, cause observable patterns. These include day and night; daily changes in the length and direction of shadows; and different positions of the sun, moon, and stars at different times of the day, month, and year.
Use observations of the sun, moon, and stars to describe patterns that can be predicted.
